  • Four transitions accelerating: from model races to value delivery; from human-AI collaboration to agent autonomy; from cloud monopolies to compute democratization; from consumer penetration to industrial disruption.

  • Compliance boundaries — AI-generated-content copyright, data privacy (in-country deployment under the AI Law), and overseas/crypto compliance need upfront assessment.
  • Information-arbitrage dividend is fading — the 2026 watershed: execution-arbitrage dividend is rising; merely “knowing how to use AI” is no longer enough — wire AI into real business workflows.

  • Lovable / Base44 follow-on growth and potential IPO/M&A moves as “one-person company valuation ceiling” anchors.

A programmer launched MoltBook, a pure AI Agent social network: humans only watch as agents post, interact, and form communities — 100K+ agents and 10M+ spectators in 48 hours, the world’s first AI-autonomous public space, pushing the “one person produces content / runs community” paradigm to its limit.
Source: Tencent · 2026-02-08

Policy & Ecosystem

The 2026 first-batch compute vouchers (apply Jun 1–30) explicitly support entities buying intelligent compute for AI R&D: enterprises, research institutes, universities, and OPC community operators. Regional vouchers keep scaling: Hangzhou ¥250M/year, Beijing up to ¥2M/company/year, Guizhou ¥80M/year — solo founders benefit directly.
Source: Sohu / Chengdu ETI · 2026-05-29

China (Inner Mongolia) FTZ was inaugurated in April 2026; the OPC community followed as the country’s first “FTZ + green compute + OPC” integrated cluster. The “2026 Global OPC Co-Creation Festival” opens in Beijing in July, inviting the next generation of AI builders.
Source: Penguin / FTZ coverage · 2026-06

Execution-Level Insights

  • Cost restructuring: What took 3–5 people now runs with 1 person + models + automation; custom enterprise AI customer service dropped from ¥500K (2023) to an expected <¥10K (2026).
  • Capability leverage: AI Agents have leapt from “assistants” to “programmable, collaborative, system-task-bearing core productivity units” — a solo founder can run a micro-enterprise covering the full business chain.
  • Overseas window: Overseas users pay more willingly for efficiency tools with less competition; AI writing / image / video tools are proving stable monthly revenue on App Store + Stripe.

⚠️ Risk note: OPC is not zero-risk. Compute cost, data compliance (in-country private deployment under the AI Law), agent reliability (demo ≠ production), and the survivor bias behind “¥600K a month” all demand sober evaluation. Startup with caution — don’t blindly charge in.

## 馃挼 6 Proven Monetization Paths (Backed by Real Cases)

Revenue model: Content monetization, brand deals, annual retainers
